additions.source_quote: מאחר עלות הביאו, הינו מאחר המיניקות, הינו נצח והוד, כי הם מיניקין לנביאים, והם בנין המלכות
additions.justification: The text explicitly states that Netzach and Hod are 'the nursing ones' (מיניקות) who nurse the prophets, and that they ARE the building of malkhut. This is a direct bechina equivalence — נצח והוד IS בנין המלכות IS the source of neginah. This concept is referenced multiple times in the Torah but does not appear as a node in a bechina edge for Torah #3 in the dataset.

additions.source_quote: על ידי שילמד שס יתקן השית עיזקאין שבקנה, שמהם יוצא הקול
additions.justification: The six rings of the windpipe (שית עיזקאין שבקנה) from which the voice (קול) emerges are the physiological anchor of the voice-repair that night-learning accomplishes. The text frames the relationship as 'learning the Shas (=night) fixes the six rings from which the voice emerges' — this is an eitza (cause-effect), but the deeper identity is that the six rings ARE the voice, and the voice IS the night (through the shamayim=kol bechina already in Package 2). The concept appears only in eitza edges in the dataset. If added as bechina, it would belong in Package 2 alongside קול.

additions.source_quote: לפיכך נשתבח דוד לפני שאול ויודע נגן, כי הנגינה היא בנין המלכות, לכך ראוי הוא למלכות
additions.justification: David the King is the paradigmatic embodiment of neginah-as-malkhut. He is praised as 'knowing how to play' precisely because music = building of malkhut, and therefore he is 'fitting for malkhut.' David is also the one who could repair even non-holy music and elevate it to holiness. He belongs in Package 1 (holy malkhut/neginah) but is not represented as a bechina node for Torah #3 in the dataset.

additions.source_quote: וסליק יתיב באילנא פרש המהרשא, שהוא בחינת אברהם, שכתוב אצלו ויטע אשל שהוא בחינת חסד, הינו שהחוט של חסד שנמשך עליו מגן עליו מן הנחש הנל
additions.justification: The thread of chesed (חוט של חסד) is the active expression of Abraham/chesed/tree — it is what the tree (=Abraham=chesed) projects as protection. In the dataset this appears in eitza edges (the thread of chesed protects against the snake), but it shares the same nature as the tree/Abraham/chesed cluster and would be a bechina node in Package 4 if added.

concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset: נצח והוד — explicitly stated as 'בנין המלכות' and source of neginah/prophecy; appears only in eitza edges in the dataset
שית עיזקאין שבקנה — the six rings of the windpipe producing the kol; referenced in eitza edges only
דוד המלך — the paradigmatic example of neginah=malkhut; present in eitza context but not a bechina node for Torah #3
חוט של חסד — the thread of chesed = the tree's protective power; present in eitza edges only

קנה (windpipe/reed) — in the teaching קנה = the physical voice apparatus. The text uses קנה both literally (windpipe rings) and metaphorically (קנה לך חבר = buy/acquire the reed whose voice unites the cherubim). Only the קול bechina is captured; the קנה itself as a bechina node is absent from the Torah #3 dataset.
גרון (throat) — 'קרא בגרון' is used as the metaphor for neginah (the cry/call from the throat); present in the aggadic interpretation but not as a bechina node
analysis_notes.note_on_polarity_of_package_1_vs_3: Torah #3 demonstrates the classic good/evil mirror structure. Package 1 (holy music/malkhut) is the exact positive mirror of Package 3 (klipah birds/evil music). The structural parallelism is explicit in the text: the holy birds nurse from the realm of prophets = holy malkhut; the klipah birds nurse from the breasts of [impure] malkhut. Both are bechina statements of the same structural type.
